purpose: A planned educational action that was never delivered must not be evaluated as a failed strategy.

decision.concept_scope: Select the correct relative-motion strategy in Grade 5 meeting problems
hypotheses: Strategy-selection weakness is more plausible than calculation weakness.
unknowns: No direct evidence about fatigue on the next planned day.
decision.why: Two eligible opportunities show repeated strategy-selection errors while arithmetic remains correct.
decision.expected_change: Select an appropriate relative-motion model with less help on a fresh comparable item.
decision.recheck_condition: After one delivered repair episode, use a fresh comparable opportunity without answer-specific help.

intervention.planned_method: Two short model-selection prompts before solving
modifications: Session cancelled because school workload was high.

outcome.comparison_basis: No comparison was performed because the planned intervention was not delivered.
outcome.interpretation: The strategy was not evaluated because it was not delivered; this is not evidence of strategy failure.
